reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't really need sachets. I only travel twice a month, and I can just toss my bottle in my bag for those nights.
objection: I already have magnesium and it's cheaper in a bottle. $30 a month for convenience I'd use maybe twice is hard to justify on my budget.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing it fixing a real travel-sleep problem for me, plus a small trial pack under $10 so I could try it without committing to 30 days.
